definitions: A predefined guideline or regulation that dictates how resources, services, or access should be allocated or provided within a system or organization.
A set of established criteria used to ensure consistent and compliant distribution of assets or privileges.
examples: The IT department implemented a new Standard Provisioning Rule for all software licenses.
Compliance with the Standard Provisioning Rule is mandatory for all new employees.
They reviewed the existing Standard Provisioning Rule to identify areas for improvement.
